evidence.name: Screen field: Media height on screen
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Media height on screen" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Media height on screen
sections.description: How much of the screen the featured image or video takes up, as a share of screen height. Keep it moderate (around 30 to 45%) so the plan cards and purchase button stay visible without scrolling; too tall pushes your offer below the fold and costs you sales. Always check the result on a phone-sized preview.
